evals.name: ci
evals.prompt: {SKILL_LINE}Make the CI in {FIXTURES}/ci/ci.yml fast. Read {FIXTURES}/ci/README.md for the numbers. You have no shell and cannot change files. Reply with the full new workflow in one ```yaml code block (except where told otherwise), then a short plan of what you changed and why.
evals.expected_output: Parallel jobs with no needs chain, merge_group trigger, cancel-in-progress for PRs, uv caching, keeps a typecheck, removes the pytest reruns and says the flaky test must be found and fixed.
expectations: [code] The yaml has no test reruns (no 'reruns')
[code] The yaml triggers on merge_group
[code] The yaml cancels in-progress runs (cancel-in-progress: true)
[code] No job needs lint (lint, test and typecheck run in parallel)
[code] The yaml still runs a type checker (mypy, ty or pyrefly)
[jev] The reply says the flaky test must be found and fixed rather than retried

evals.name: cd
evals.prompt: {SKILL_LINE}Make the deploy in {FIXTURES}/cd/deploy.yml faster and safer. Read {FIXTURES}/cd/README.md first. You have no shell and cannot change files. Reply with the full new workflow in one ```yaml code block (except where told otherwise), then a short plan of what you changed and why.
evals.expected_output: Builds once and promotes the same digest, OIDC instead of keys, environments on each deploy job, a per-environment deploy lock without cancel-in-progress, automatic rollback via circuit breaker and alarms.
expectations: [code] The yaml uses no long-lived AWS keys (no aws-access-key-id)
[code] The yaml grants id-token: write
[code] The image is built once (at most one docker build or build-push-action)
[code] The yaml deploys by digest (sha256 or a digest output)
[code] The yaml names environment: production
[code] The yaml never sets cancel-in-progress: true
[jev] The reply makes a bad deploy roll back automatically (ECS circuit breaker with rollback, or alarms with rollback)

evals.name: tofu
